title: Lock

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Outputs a signal that can be locked on/off with a physical key

body:
"A structure that comes with a key! Outputs a signal of 10.0 when the lock is turned. The signal may stay activated if the key is taken out while the lock is turned."

The Lock is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It is a keyhole with an included key.

Functionality

When first placed, the Lock includes a skeleton key in its keyway. It is similar in appearance to the Adurite Key, albeit silver in color. As long as the key is still in the keyway, the user can turn the key by pressing V. If the keyway is perpendicular to the output port, the Lock emits a signal of 0. If the keyway is parallel with the output port, the Lock emits a signal of 10. If the key is removed from the keyway by pressing F, then the Lock can no longer be operated. A separate object, the LogicKey, will eject from the Lock when this happens. This key cannot be added to one's inventory. To reinsert the key, the user must drag the LogicKey back on top of the Lock, where it will insert itself similar to placing a record on the Blue Vinyl Player. Any LogicKey can be inserted into any open Lock.
